basis: manual reward-only repair after the stopped cycle-4 retry reached 19/26 pass (73.1%)

changes.description: Compact shell output above 20k characters to a bounded head/tail view while preserving complete stdout/stderr paths; compact old tool results when model context reaches 55%.
changes.evidence: Two failed cleaned traces accumulated about 284k and 604k tokens and ended without a normal final response.

changes.description: Move sparse delivery checkpoints to 5/10/15 minutes; detect successful temporary candidates; conditionally continue only when explicit task paths remain untouched or a required background job is pending.
changes.evidence: A publicly verified candidate was left in a temporary command instead of being written to /app/out.html, and another task ended immediately after starting a required background install.

changes.description: Conditionally grant one recovery turn when a required runtime is unavailable and only syntax/interface checks support the final response.
changes.evidence: A distributed PyTorch implementation finalized after syntax/AST checks without executing output or gradient behavior.

changes.description: After download timeout, require resumable authoritative transfer or a verifiable mirror, recommend quiet progress logs, and warn against synthetic/fake substitutes.
changes.evidence: A slow official CIFAR-10 download timed out and was replaced by locally generated patterned records, invalidating the resulting accuracy.

preserved_contracts: original run_shell_command schema and success/error/timeout/background result keys
normal final responses with delivered paths and adequate evidence are not intercepted
the stopped retry experiment remains immutable and is not resumed
deliberate_non_change: No benchmark-task dataset or dependency is silently baked into E2B templates. Task-specific predownloads would change the Terminal-Bench environment; resumable authoritative downloads are improved without changing benchmark inputs.
